SE Focus · Q3

Build Momentum: Raise Transfer Start Rate from 35% to 45%

One of Sales Enablement’s top priorities is increasing transfer start rate by 10 percentage points by the end of Q3.

🎯
What sales needs to know: The team target is to move transfer start rate from 35% to 45% by the end of Q3.
🔎
Why this is the focus: A detailed Gong analysis found the leading reason opportunities fail to reach transfer start is customer inertia and competing priorities delaying commitment.
⚡
How it impacts your day-to-day: Capture customer momentum by setting firm next steps and creating urgency before an opportunity stalls. The next few weeks of micros will reinforce this motion.
Coaching loop: SE will monitor individual and team progress in Gong, leave coaching and feedback directly on calls, and host targeted 1:1 coaching sessions.
🧩 Product
Go-Live · Payroll

Failed Direct Deposit: Print a Paper Check While Funds Clear

The Manage Payment flow no longer leaves payroll admins at a provider error when a refund cannot yet be created.

Before: provider error · After: clear guidance and an immediate paper-check option
🧾
What sales needs to know: When a worker’s direct deposit fails while payroll funds are still clearing, the admin can retry direct deposit or print a paper check from the warning message.
💡
Why it changed: The prior flow surfaced a raw refund error and made it appear that the worker could not be paid until clearing completed.
💬
How it impacts your day-to-day: Don’t tell customers they must wait to pay the worker. Paper-check printing is available immediately; Homebase may continue to show direct deposit until the automatic refund completes in 1–2 business days.
Live July 14: Web only, no feature flag. Open the source announcement.
Admin Visual Update · Live

Admin Now Shows Current and Future-Dated Payroll Packages

The Payroll Package row now distinguishes what is active today from what is scheduled next, eliminating the misleading “No price package assigned” state when a future package already exists.

The four admin states: current only · scheduled only · current + scheduled · no package
📦
What sales needs to know: Admin now shows the current package and any scheduled future package, including the future effective date. The company-package list link appears when either one exists.
👀
Why it changed: A future-only package previously looked like no package had been configured, and a scheduled change was invisible when a current package also existed.
🛠️
How it impacts your day-to-day: Check the full Payroll Package row before treating an account as unconfigured. This is an information improvement; no new rep action is required.
Live July 17: Open the source thread.
Coming Soon · Mobile v5.12

Biometric Sign-In Is Coming to the Mobile Apps

Face ID, Touch ID, and Android fingerprint sign-in are targeting production with mobile app v5.12 during the week of July 27.

▶ Demo 1: Email sign-in + Face ID setup
▶ Demo 2: Phone sign-in + enrollment
📱
What sales needs to know: Supported personal devices will prompt users to enroll after sign-in or owner sign-up. Biometrics can then trigger automatically at app launch and can be used for sensitive-action reauthentication.
🔐
Why it’s happening: Device-bound sign-in reduces repeated password and SMS-code friction and supports the longer-term move toward passwordless access.
🧩
How it impacts your day-to-day: Users get three biometric attempts before OTP fallback and can enable or disable the feature under Settings → Password & security. Traditional sign-in remains available.
Visual collateral: Watch either mobile flow above or open the biometric sign-in designs in Figma.
⚙️ CS Ops / Payroll
Support Process · Check

Check Refile Requests Can Be Submitted Before Funds Settle—But Stay Blocked

Use the correct Check support path for filing and refile cases, and set expectations when recollection is still outstanding.

📂
What sales needs to know: Customers can still submit a refile request while Check is recollecting funds, but submitting the request does not remove the funding blocker.
🔄
Why it works this way: Check must successfully recollect the funds before the filing can sync and become eligible to move forward.
⏳
How it impacts your day-to-day: The refile will stay blocked until Check recollects the funds on their end—approximately four business days to settle once recollection is created. After that, the filing syncs automatically and the refile can proceed.
Expectation to set: A submitted refile request can remain blocked during the recollection window; customers do not need to submit a duplicate request.
📊 RevOps / Workflow
Pricing Experiment · 100%

Payroll Pricing Experiment Expands to 100%

The payroll pricing experiment has expanded from limited exposure to its full intended audience.

💯
What sales needs to know: The tested payroll pricing experience is now at 100% exposure for the experiment’s intended audience.
🧪
Why it’s happening: Full exposure gives the team a complete read on the experiment rather than relying on a partial traffic sample.
🧾
How it impacts your day-to-day: Treat the pricing and package shown in the live customer flow and approved sales tools as the source of truth. Don’t quote from memory if the customer’s experience differs.
Guardrail: This remains an experiment. Do not invent eligibility, pricing, or package details that are not visible in the approved source of truth.
Workflow Follow-Up · July 23

IMP Calendly Selector Moves to the Front of the Wizard

A direct follow-up to Issue #19’s new Salesforce-to-Implementation handoff workflow.

▶ Watch: Updated IMP workflow walkthrough
⚡
What’s changing / day-to-day: We heard your feedback and the IMP Calendly selector will move to the front of the IMP wizard tomorrow, Thurs July 23rd.
